summary: First-iteration end-to-end test of OllieStreamy. Backend: 10/10 pytest API tests passed (root, livetv countries/categories/channels/channel/probe-status/proxy validation). Frontend: Home hero + rows, Movies/TV browse, Search, Movie & TV detail with iframe player (vidsrc.xyz) and server switcher, TV episode selector, Sports/Kids/Discord pages, Live TV country list (10,033 channels / 179 countries) and channel playback with HLS <video> and auto-failover message all render. Login (localStorage mock) submits and populates localStorage. No blocking bugs found.

integration_issues.issue: After successful mock login via /login, URL stays on /login (no redirect to /home). localStorage is populated correctly (watch_history key present). Non-blocking.

issues: React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Appears on multiple pages. Should wrap text directly inside <option> without <span>.
'TV Shows', 'Live TV', 'Watch History', 'Sign Up' nav items wrap onto two lines at 1920 width due to narrow nav spacing — minor polish.

action_items: Optional: redirect to '/' (or previous page) after successful login/signup for better UX.
Optional: remove <span> wrappers from <option> children to clear hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined AFTER being referenced inside `_background_probe` / `livetv_sync`. Works because functions are called later, but better to configure logging before route definitions.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')` — consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
No data-testid attributes present on interactive elements across the app; adds friction for future automation (not required by spec, but recommended).
LiveTV channel detail endpoint re-probes with 12s timeout on every request — may be heavy under load; probe loop already runs every 15 min.
test_credentials: None required — auth is a localStorage mock (any email/password works).
seed_data_creation: None. Live TV catalog auto-synced from iptv-org on first API call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run via `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. All 10 pass. Frontend routes: /, /movies, /tv, /trending, /sports, /livetv, /kids, /discord, /history, /search, /movie/:id, /tv/:id, /cast/:type/:id, /login, /signup. Note: /cast and /auth are NOT routes — correct paths are /cast/:type/:id and /login or /signup. Upstream HLS streams can be dead (iptv-org); the app shows a friendly off-air banner and failover — this is expected per the review request and NOT a bug.
